name: screen-copy-tagged-buffers
source:
Cls 1
Double Buffer
Autoback 0
Cls 2
Screen Copy Logic To Physic
Cls 3
Screen Copy Physic To Logic
Print Point(0,0),Logic,Physic

encoding.notes: Literal catalogue words assembled without the production encoder/table: Cls 0bb8, Double Buffer 012c, Autoback 0e2c, Screen Copy 0986, Logic 01c8, Physic 0e16, To 0094, Point 0e56.

evidence.notes: Raw logical-to-physical and physical-to-logical copies retain distinct buffers. Bare Logic is BFFFFFFF and Physic is FFFFFFFF. Derived from original source, not an Amiga execution capture.
